name: opencode-mastra-om
description: Enhanced Mastra Observational Memory plugin for OpenCode — persistent cross-session memory with observation, reflection, and manual trigger tools
author: Rick Ross

scripts.build: bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --target node --external @opencode-ai/plugin --external @opencode-ai/sdk && node -e "const v=require('./package.json').version; const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('versions/v'+v,{recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync('dist/index.js','versions/v'+v+'/index.js'); console.log('saved versions/v'+v+'/index.js')"
